items.summary: Reject both new proposals this cycle. Attribution is incomplete, direct costs are unavailable, zero outcomes are proven, and the proposed guardrail may duplicate existing controls. Preserve only existing bounded, reversible workstreams and their measurement gates. Do not queue work, change production, alter telemetry, spend, or make revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, or forecast claims. Keep SearchWoot private pending owner direction and unresolved rights, legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Recommendation: continue three existing bounded, reversible workstreams—marineactivity.com AIS baseline, aliencouncil.com UAP baseline, and fishhooklabs.com guide improvement—and route them to engineer with their existing measurement gates. Reject new monetization, unsupported revenue claims, high-priority queue work, telemetry duplication, production expansion, and SearchWoot launch activity. Aggregate Amazon commission is $4.92 and unattributed; site revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts remain unsupported. Owner decision: authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request, keep SearchWoot private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit.
